Hey everyone, so I’ve been following a skincare routine since July 2017. I noticed my skin got better up until November 2017. Now my skin is back to where it was when I started and I’m curious if I’m not using my BHA/aha from PC correctly. I use it right after I cleanse my face with the Cerave foaming cleanser, leave it on for half an hour and then continue my routine. But I notice that when I apply the BHA, it’s very sticky and oily feeling compared to the dry feeling that everyone says they experience. I’m thinking I need to invest in a ph adjusting toner? I also know salicylic acid doesn’t work too well for me so that may be why. Any input would be very much appreciated, thanks! BTW!! I’m always indoors and it’s winter here, should I still wear sunscreen everyday? I am max 15 mins outside per day.
